extra.text: Before lamps, before oil, before brave speeches: cord. Craft four lengths of plant-fiber rope for the crews.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Twist it tight. A lantern dropped is a darkness doubled.

decline.text: No blame. Night work must be taken willingly or not at all.

in_progress.text: Four lengths will rig the first stretch of lane.

ready.text: Good cordage. Pull hard; I want no polite knots.

extra.text: It holds. The first lamps may leave the shed tonight.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
